reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including the new setLastMonthSpending, take their categories from one getMonthWideTargetCategories helper, and the #fixed check reuses the existing extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied category queries; only the per-action `is_income && !isTrackingBudget()` skip remains repeated in each loop, as in the original code.

placement.why: Selection helper and the new action live in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions; the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the four requested steps, though the single release note only describes the first step.

maintainability.why: One selection function with a typed shared args type owns every exclusion; the rule is split between SQL (hidden, templates) and a JS filter (#fixed) and its comment slightly misstates which exclusions the flag lifts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth via a target-id set, goes through getMonthWideTargetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repeated income-skip check is the pre-existing per-action line, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in budget/actions.ts gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter, applied as a single `? = 1 OR (hidden...)` SQL condition; no caller bypasses it.
